dct_description_sm: Title from legend.; Relief shown pictorially.; Includes index map.; Each sheet includes an ""Index of Places"" (list of cities, towns, and other inhabited locations on the sheet) with 1930 population figures.; Shows roads, railroads, power and telephone lines, bench marks and triangulation stations, drainage ditches and pipes, airports, radio stations, churches, schools, parks, cemeteries, town halls, creameries, golf courses, resorts, tourist camps, disposal plants, filling stations, immigration and customs ports, tribal reservations, state and county institutions, lighthouses, forests, mines, quarries, and gravel pits.; ""Hennepin 27.""--Printed in lower right margin; ""Copyright 1936.""; ""County Maps. S/y 1/4 of Henn. Carver + Wright.""--Marked in red pencil on verso of Sheet 3.
